name: electrify-firebase-deploy
description: Pins the firebase-tools tree used by the prod deploy workflow to deploy Firestore rules and indexes. Kept out of the root package.json on purpose: firebase-tools pulls in ~490 transitive packages that only the deploy job needs, and putting it there would add them to every contributor's install and to every PR test run. The deploy job runs `npm ci` here, so the version that touches a Google service-account credential is the one this lockfile pins, not whatever the registry serves that day.
